title: Install as an app
already: CannonCommander already runs as an app
installed: CannonCommander is installed as an app now
declined: Not installed. The Help menu offers it again any time.
head: CannonCommander as an app
intro: A window of its own without an address bar, an icon on the home screen or in the taskbar. On a phone you can share files from other apps straight to it.
how: How it works in your browser
notOffered: Your browser does not offer the install by itself right now

chrome.head: Chrome and Edge on a computer
chrome.how: Click the install icon on the right of the address bar, or choose Install app in the browser menu.

android.head: Android
android.how: Tap Install app or Add to home screen in the browser menu.

ios.head: iPhone and iPad
ios.how: Tap Share in Safari, then Add to Home Screen.

firefox.head: Firefox
firefox.how: On Android tap Install in the menu. On Windows Firefox offers an icon in the address bar for it, otherwise a bookmark does the job.

description: File manager for your Unraid server, with two windows like Krusader
